sloka: सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वाररान् ।ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम् ।। ५.३९.८।।।।
transliteration: sugrīvaṁ ca sahāmātyaṁ vṛddhān sarvāṁśca vārarān ।brūyāstvaṁ vānaraśreṣṭha kuśalaṁ dharmasaṁhitam ।। 5.39.8।।।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.
